description: Build the complete Next.js frontend UI foundation - premium SaaS design system with ShadCN UI, dashboard layout, navigation, dark/light theme, all page shells for the 11 main pages, and reusable component library with glassmorphism and modern styling.
steps: Install frontend dependencies: @radix-ui/react-* primitives, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react, framer-motion, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, next-themes, recharts, cmdk (command palette)

Set up ShadCN UI configuration: create components.json, lib/utils.ts with cn() helper, set up the ShadCN component system with custom theme variables in globals.css supporting dark/light mode with premium color palette (deep blues, purples, electric accents)

Create the ShadCN UI components needed: Button, Card, Input, Label, Select, Tabs, Badge, Avatar, DropdownMenu, Sheet, Dialog, Command, Separator, ScrollArea, Tooltip, Progress, Skeleton, Switch, Textarea - all in src/components/ui/
Create the app theme provider in src/components/providers/theme-provider.tsx using next-themes, and query-provider.tsx for React Query, wrap in src/app/layout.tsx

Build the main dashboard layout in src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx with: collapsible sidebar navigation (all 11 pages with icons), top header bar with search command palette, user avatar dropdown, theme toggle, notification bell, project selector dropdown

Create the sidebar component src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx - premium design with glassmorphism background, smooth expand/collapse animation with Framer Motion, active state indicators, grouped navigation sections (Main: Dashboard, AI Chat; SEO Tools: Audit, Keywords, Content Writer, Topical Maps, Rank Tracker, Backlinks, Technical SEO; Settings: Settings, Billing)
Create the header component src/components/layout/header.tsx with command palette (Cmd+K), breadcrumbs, project selector, notifications dropdown, user menu

Create dashboard page src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx with: overview stats cards (Projects, Keywords Tracked, Pages Audited, Content Score), recent activity feed, quick actions grid, AI agent status cards, mini charts using Recharts

Create SEO Audit page shell src/app/(dashboard)/audit/page.tsx with: URL input form to start audit, recent audits table, audit score visualization (circular progress), tabbed view for issues (Critical, Warnings, Passed, Info)

Create Keyword Explorer page shell src/app/(dashboard)/keywords/page.tsx with: search input, keyword results table with columns (Keyword, Volume, KD, CPC, Intent, Trend), filters sidebar, keyword cluster visualization

Create AI Content Writer page shell src/app/(dashboard)/content/page.tsx with: split-pane editor layout (left: content editor with toolbar, right: SEO score panel with NLP terms, readability, optimization suggestions), content list/history

Create AI SEO Chat page shell src/app/(dashboard)/chat/page.tsx with: ChatGPT-style interface, message bubbles, streaming text animation placeholder, suggested prompts grid, conversation history sidebar
Create Topical Maps page shell src/app/(dashboard)/topical-maps/page.tsx with: project selector, visual map placeholder area, topic list sidebar, create new map button/dialog

Create Rank Tracker page shell src/app/(dashboard)/rank-tracker/page.tsx with: keyword table with rank positions, rank change indicators (up/down arrows with colors), line chart for rank history, filters for country/device
Create Backlinks page shell src/app/(dashboard)/backlinks/page.tsx with: backlink table (URL, DA, Anchor, Status, Type), dofollow/nofollow filter, referring domains count, backlink growth chart
Create Technical SEO page shell src/app/(dashboard)/technical-seo/page.tsx with: Core Web Vitals cards (LCP, FID, CLS with gauges), crawl stats, issues list, sitemap status
Create Settings page shell src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx with tabbed layout: Profile, Team, API Keys, Integrations, Notifications
Create Billing page shell src/app/(dashboard)/billing/page.tsx with: current plan card, plan comparison grid (Free/Pro/Agency with features), usage meters, invoice history

Create reusable components: src/components/shared/stat-card.tsx (animated counter), src/components/shared/data-table.tsx (generic sortable/filterable table), src/components/shared/score-ring.tsx (circular progress), src/components/shared/empty-state.tsx, src/components/shared/page-header.tsx, src/components/shared/loading-skeleton.tsx
Add Framer Motion page transitions in layout, card hover effects, and smooth micro-animations throughout
Ensure full responsive design - mobile sidebar becomes sheet drawer, tables become card views on mobile
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors in the frontend
All 11 pages render without errors (verified by successful build)
Dark/light mode toggle works via next-themes
Sidebar navigation links to all pages correctly
Responsive layout - sidebar collapses on mobile
ShadCN UI components are properly configured and importable
Tailwind CSS custom theme with premium color variables is applied
All pages have proper loading states with skeleton components
